hero.eyebrow: Exclusive Curation Grim x François Poulat
hero.description: The contemporary energy of streaming and the Pop Art icon united on a masterful physical canvas. Selected by Grim to dress the background of his studio, the original artwork by François Poulat is is hand-painted on Alu-Dibond.

genese.intro: Before thousands of enthusiasts, François Poulat’s "PikaPoulat" canvas made a spectacular entrance on Grim’s stream. From its very first moments on screen to its final installation under the spotlight, this 50×50 cm contemporary piece took over the set, transforming the atmosphere of the setup forever.
genese.body: InRealArt orchestrated the high-end transfer from François Poulat's studio to Grim's setup. Custom transport, full insurance coverage, and a hand-signed certificate of authenticity: every detail was crafted to guarantee a flawless delivery.

origin.question: Where are the artworks made?
origin.answer: All physical editions are 100% made and assembled in France. Every print is carefully framed, varnished, and inspected locally to guarantee the highest standard of French art craftsmanship.

payment.question: How does the 75% deposit payment work?
payment.answer: When you place your order, you pay a 75% deposit via our secure Stripe checkout to cover production costs and lock your place in the queue. The remaining 25% balance is requested once the piece passes final quality inspection and is ready to ship.

delivery.question: What are the production and delivery times?
delivery.answer: Since each artwork is individually prepared, hand-varnished, and mounted on its frame, please allow 2 to 3 weeks for production. Express delivery then takes 48 to 72 hours via specialized artwork carriers with real-time priority tracking.

packaging.question: How is the artwork packaged for transport?
packaging.answer: Each piece is wrapped in a moisture-protective film, encased in high-density protective foam, and shipped in a custom-engineered reinforced heavy-duty box designed to resist shocks and ensure safe transit.

certificate.question: Does the artwork come with a Certificate of Authenticity?
certificate.answer: Yes. Every physical artwork comes with its physical Certificate of Authenticity, sealed, numbered, and hand-signed by the artist François Poulat.

paymentMethods.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.answer: We process all transactions securely through Stripe. You can pay using major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) as well as Apple Pay and Google Pay.

damage.question: What happens if the artwork arrives damaged?
damage.answer: In the rare event of transit damage, notify us within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the package and the artwork. We will immediately arrange a priority collection and ship a replacement piece at no extra cost to you.

shipping.question: Do you ship internationally?
shipping.answer: Yes, we ship worldwide using fully insured, specialized art carriers. Shipping fees and estimated transit times are automatically calculated at checkout based on your delivery address.

scope.heading: Article 1 — Purpose and scope
scope.body:
These Terms and Conditions of Sale ("T&Cs") exclusively govern sales of products concluded on the page inrealart.com ("the Site") between the company INREALART ("the Seller") and any natural person acting for purposes outside their professional activity ("the Customer" or "the Consumer").

Any order implies full and unreserved acceptance of these T&Cs, which the Customer acknowledges having read before validating their order, by ticking the box provided for that purpose. The applicable T&Cs are those in force on the date of the order.

The Seller reserves the right to amend these T&Cs at any time. The applicable version is archived and may be provided on request. Version in force as of: 28 August 2026.

The products offered are the canvases and printed artworks described on the Site. Each product is presented with a description of its essential characteristics (dimensions, support material, printing technique and quality, finish, etc.).

The photographs and visuals illustrating the products have no contractual value and may show slight differences from the actual product, in particular colour rendering depending on the screen used. Such differences shall not engage the Seller's liability nor constitute a lack of conformity.

Limited / numbered editions: the print run, numbering and, where applicable, the certificate of authenticity provided are specified in the description of the relevant artwork.

prices.heading: Article 4 — Prices
prices.body:
Prices are stated in euros, inclusive of all taxes, excluding delivery costs which are mentioned separately before order validation. The total price due by the Customer (products + any delivery costs) is summarised on the order page before payment.

The Seller reserves the right to change its prices at any time, it being understood that the price applied is the one in force at the time the order is validated.

Any announcement of a price reduction indicates the lowest prior price applied during the preceding 30 days (art. L112-1-1 of the French Consumer Code).

order.heading: Article 5 — Ordering
order.body:
The Customer selects the product(s), checks the details of their order and total price, corrects any errors, then confirms the order. Validation is carried out using the "double click" process: after checking the summary, the Customer definitively confirms by clicking the button bearing the wording "Order with obligation to pay".

The sale is only considered final after confirmation of acceptance of the order by the Seller, sent by email, and collection of the full price. The Seller sends an acknowledgement of receipt summarising the order.

The Seller reserves the right to refuse or cancel any order from a Customer with whom there is a dispute relating to payment of a previous order, or in the event of an abnormal order (quantity, suspicion of fraud).

payment.heading: Article 6 — Payment
payment.body:
Payment is made online by bank card via the payment service provider Stripe. Payment data is transmitted securely and is neither processed nor stored by the Seller. The debit takes place at the time the order is validated.

The order is only registered after confirmation of payment by the provider. If payment is refused, the order is automatically cancelled. The Seller may suspend or cancel any order in the event of non-payment, irregular payment or fraud.

delivery.heading: Article 7 — Delivery
delivery.body:
Areas served: mainland France.
Delivery time: 5 to 10 business days from confirmation of the order. In accordance with art. L216-1 of the French Consumer Code, failing any indication, delivery takes place no later than 30 days after conclusion of the contract.
Delivery costs: indicated before order validation.

In the event of late delivery, the Customer may, after having instructed the Seller to deliver within a reasonable additional period that has remained without effect, terminate the contract by registered letter or in writing on another durable medium. Sums paid are then refunded no later than 14 days following termination (art. L216-6 and L216-7).

On receipt, the Customer is invited to check the condition of the parcel and the product and to report any apparent damage or non-conformity to the carrier and the Seller as soon as possible.

ownership.heading: Article 8 — Transfer of ownership and risk
ownership.body: Transfer of ownership is deferred until full payment of the price by the Customer. Transfer of the risk of loss or damage occurs when the Customer, or a third party designated by them, takes physical possession of the product (art. L216-4 of the French Consumer Code).

withdrawal.heading: Article 9 — Right of withdrawal
withdrawal.body:
Standard canvases (non-personalised): the Customer has a period of 14 days from receipt of the product to exercise their right of withdrawal, without having to give reasons. They inform the Seller of their decision using the model form below or any unambiguous statement, before the deadline expires.

The Customer returns the product without undue delay and no later than 14 days after communicating their decision. Return costs are borne by the Customer. The Seller refunds all sums paid, including standard delivery costs, no later than 14 days after being informed, and may defer the refund until recovery of the product or proof of its dispatch. The Customer's liability may be engaged in the event of depreciation of the product resulting from handling other than that necessary.

Model withdrawal form: "To INREALART, 6 rue du château d'eau, 37260 Artannes-sur-Indre, teaminrealart@gmail.com: I hereby notify you of my withdrawal from the contract for the sale of the product below — ordered on … / received on … — Name, address, signature (if on paper), date."

Personalised or made-to-order canvases: in accordance with article L221-28 3° of the French Consumer Code, the right of withdrawal cannot be exercised for goods made to the Customer's specifications or clearly personalised (name, photo, format or variant produced on request). The Customer is informed of this before ordering and acknowledges it when validating the order. The applicable category is stated in the description of each product.

warranties.heading: Article 10 — Legal guarantees
warranties.body:
Regardless of any commercial warranty, the Seller remains bound by the legal guarantees of conformity (art. L217-3 et seq. of the French Consumer Code) and against hidden defects (art. 1641 et seq. of the French Civil Code).

The consumer has a period of two years from delivery of the goods to act under the legal guarantee of conformity. They may choose between repair or replacement of the goods, subject to the cost conditions provided for in article L217-12 of the Consumer Code. They are exempt from proving the existence of the lack of conformity during the twenty-four months following delivery of the goods.

The legal guarantee of conformity applies independently of any commercial warranty granted. The consumer may decide to invoke the guarantee against hidden defects of the item sold within the meaning of article 1641 of the Civil Code. In this case, they may choose between rescission of the sale or a reduction of the sale price in accordance with article 1644 of the Civil Code.

The Customer may invoke these guarantees by writing to the contact details given in Article 2. The costs of returning the non-conforming product are borne by the Seller in this context.

liability.heading: Article 11 — Liability
liability.body: The Seller cannot be held liable for non-performance of the contract in the event of force majeure, the act of a third party, or fault of the Customer. The Seller's liability is limited, to the extent permitted by law, to the amount of the order, without prejudice to the Consumer's mandatory rights.

intellectualProperty.heading: Article 12 — Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.body: All elements of the Site and the products (visuals, artworks, trademarks, texts) are protected by intellectual property law. The sale of a canvas does not entail any assignment of the copyright or exploitation rights attached to the work. Any unauthorised reproduction or commercial exploitation is prohibited.

data.heading: Article 13 — Personal data
data.body: Data collected in connection with the order is processed in accordance with the Privacy Policy accessible on the Site, established pursuant to the GDPR and the French Data Protection Act.

claims.heading: Article 14 — Complaints and consumer mediation

Any complaint may be sent to the Seller: teaminrealart@gmail.com.

influencerDisclosure.metaDescription: Information on paid partnerships, advertising disclosure and compliance of influencer content related to the InRealArt operation.
influencerDisclosure.title: Transparency & commercial influence
influencerDisclosure.reference: French law no. 2023-451 of 9 June 2023 on commercial influence, amended by order no. 2024-978 of 6 November 2024; French Consumer Code; GDPR; platform-specific rules.

advertisingDisclosure.heading: 1. Advertising disclosure
advertisingDisclosure.body:
Any content published by an influencer as part of the operation is a commercial communication: it is identified as such in a clear, legible and immediately identifiable way, for its entire duration.

Accepted wording: "Advertising" or "Commercial collaboration". Equivalent wording is tolerated ("partnership", "sponsored", "in collaboration with…") provided it is equally clear and understandable.

Ambiguous wording, or English-language wording poorly understood by the French public (#ad, #sponso), or a disclosure buried among hashtags, are prohibited. The "paid partnership" tool on Instagram/TikTok is not sufficient on its own: the explicit disclosure also appears in the content itself.

Penalties: up to 2 years' imprisonment and a €300,000 fine, and a ban from practising, in the event of missing disclosure or misleading practice. The advertiser may be jointly liable.

twitchLive.heading: 2. Twitch live
twitchLive.body:
The advertising disclosure is visible and audible for the entire duration of the live stream, not only at the start: a clear spoken announcement at the beginning of the live AND a continuously visible reminder (live title, "Commercial collaboration" panel/overlay, banner).

The nature of the partnership is restated each time the product or promo code is promoted again during the live. A record of the live (VOD, screenshot) is kept as proof of compliance in the event of an inspection.

Any scarcity element shown during the live (stock countdown, "only X left") must be truthful.

instagram.heading: 3. Instagram / TikTok posts and stories
instagram.body:
The "Paid partnership" tool is enabled AND the explicit disclosure is added at the very start of the caption or as an overlay on the story.

On a video story, the disclosure remains legible for the entire viewing duration. Each separate post carries its own disclosure: a compliant story does not cover the following ones.

The link or sticker leading to the landing page points to a page where the T&Cs, legal notice and privacy policy are accessible.

unboxing.heading: 4. Unboxing and product presentation
unboxing.body:
A paid unboxing, or one carried out in exchange for consideration (including a free product), is a commercial communication: the same disclosure obligation applies.

Statements about the quality, material, origin or "handmade" / "limited edition" nature of the canvases are accurate and verifiable; any exaggeration may constitute a misleading commercial practice.

Retouched or virtual images: if the appearance of the product or of the person is altered (filters, retouching, AI), the wording "Retouched images" or "Virtual images" is mandatory. Omitting it is punishable by 1 year's imprisonment and a €4,500 fine.

claims.heading: 5. Truthfulness of claims and sales messaging
claims.body:
No false claim or claim likely to mislead (artificial scarcity, fake reviews, unkept promises about delivery times).

Price reductions: if the operation includes a promo code or a struck-through launch price, the reference price displayed is the lowest price applied during the preceding 30 days (art. L112-1-1 of the French Consumer Code).

Promo codes and affiliation: the commission earned by the influencer via a code remains compatible with transparency about the commercial nature of the content.

giveaway.heading: 6. Prize draw / giveaway
giveaway.body:
A set of rules is drafted (organiser, dates, entry terms, prize, designation of winners, free entry).

The rules of each platform are respected (Instagram and Twitch in particular prohibit encouraging users to tag fake accounts).

Filing the rules with a judicial officer is no longer mandatory but remains recommended as evidence; the rules are kept available on request.

minors.heading: 7. Underage audience
minors.body:
If the audience includes a significant proportion of minors, the clarity of the disclosures is reinforced and any excessive incitement to purchase is avoided.

The absence of promotion of products or services prohibited to minors is verified.

data.heading: 8. Personal data during the operation
data.body:
Buyer data collected via the landing page falls under InRealArt's privacy policy; the influencer does not have access to it unless there is a legal basis and an explicit notice.

For a giveaway, participant data constitutes a separate processing operation (information, legal basis, retention period, deletion after the draw).

contract.heading: 9. Contract and invoicing
contract.body:
The collaboration contract covers the specific operation: deliverables, disclosures imposed on the influencer, assignment of rights to the content, exclusivity, remuneration, liability in the event of breach.

If the live or the posts are reused in InRealArt's advertising, the contract provides for the assignment of rights (including the influencer's image) and the authorised media and durations.

Invoicing and VAT for the influencer service are handled normally; invoices and proof of consideration (including the valued amount of free products) are kept.

checklist.heading: 10. Pre-launch checklist
checklist.body:
• T&Cs, legal notice, privacy policy and cookie policy online and accessible from the landing page.
• Compliant cookie banner (accept and reject at the same level) active before any non-essential tracker.
• Order button worded "… with obligation to pay" and a summary before payment.
• Consumer mediator subscribed and mentioned in the T&Cs.
• Advertising disclosures agreed with the influencer for each format (live, post, story, unboxing).
• "Retouched / virtual images" wording planned if retouching is used.
• Price and promo rules checked if a promo code is used (30-day reference price).
• Giveaway rules ready if a giveaway is planned.
• Records kept (VOD, screenshots, contract, invoices).

Informational note for practical guidance — it does not constitute personalised legal advice. A review by a lawyer before launch is recommended.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.reference: Article 82 of the French Data Protection Act — CNIL guidelines. Version in force as of 28 August 2026.

whatIsACookie.heading: 1. What is a cookie?
whatIsACookie.body: A cookie is a file placed on your device when you visit a website. It is used in particular to ensure the website functions, to remember preferences, or to measure audience.

cookiesUsed.heading: 2. Cookies used
cookiesUsed.body:
Strictly necessary cookies — essential to operation (cart, session, Stripe payment, security). Exempt from consent.

Audience measurement cookies — analytics tool, subject to consent unless configured for exemption. [to be completed with the actual tool]

Marketing and social media cookies — campaign tracking pixel, subject to consent. [to be completed with the actual trackers]

A detailed table listing each cookie (name, purpose, issuer, retention period — 13 months maximum for trackers subject to consent) will be published here once the tools are finalised.

consent.heading: 3. Your consent
consent.body: On your first visit, a banner allows you to accept or refuse the placement of non-essential cookies. You can change your choices at any time via the cookie management module accessible on the site. No non-essential tracker is placed before your consent is obtained.

browserSettings.heading: 4. Browser settings
browserSettings.body: You can also configure your browser to block or delete cookies. However, this setting may impair certain features of the site.
